_about: Local export of epic PAY-100 and its stories, in the same shape as JIRA REST /rest/api/2/issue/<key>?expand=names. Edit a story here to see only that story's test cases regenerate.

fields.description: Improve domestic payment controls for release 4.2: daily limits, amount validation, account status checks and step-up authentication.

As a retail customer I want a daily transfer limit so that my exposure to fraud is capped.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* A retail customer can transfer up to 10,000 USD per calendar day across all domestic transfers
* A transfer that would exceed the daily limit is rejected with error code PAY-LIMIT-001
* The daily limit resets at 00:00 in the customer's home timezone

h3. Notes
Limit applies to the sum of all domestic transfers, not per transfer.

Validate the transfer amount and accounts before a transfer is submitted.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
# Minimum transfer amount is 1.00
# Amount must have at most 2 decimal places
# Source and destination account cannot be the same

Block debits from accounts that are not in good standing.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* Given an account in status FROZEN or CLOSED
* When the customer submits a transfer
* Then the transfer is rejected
* Given a DORMANT account
* When any debit is attempted
* Then it is rejected until the account is reactivated

fields.customfield_10045:

* OTP expires after 300 seconds

fields.description: As a customer I want to see my most recent payees when I start a transfer. The list shows the payee name and the masked account number. Selecting a payee pre-fills the destination account.
